text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about
with Buena Vista...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hey look, it's a Paka Petit!

Looking in the direction Buena Vista points,
I see a crane game filled with plushies
modeled after various Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fufu... How nostalgic. That was the very first claw machine game the two of us ever played together.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Back then, it was a Paka-Petit too.
...Do you remember?"

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That plushie!
It's the exact same one I have at home!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
There are so many friends here...!
Fufu, I want to show that kid too.
choice_data_list: In that case... shall I get it for you?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That was so fun... You kept trying over and over
until you finally won it for me, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"We were still small back then, so we couldn't see all the way in.
The two of us stretched on our tiptoes as high as we could..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Wanna hang out for just a bit?
choice_data_list: That's the spirit! Keep your expectations high for next time too!

text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
